scope: Three new semi-supervised objectives, each with seeds 2026092701/02/03, single source receiver m1-natural, full old three-view PAMF with reference response. Main split excluded. Historical target scores were exposed; this is development evaluation.
motivation: A physical transformation of the same received source-U packet provides paired observations without requiring two distinct packets to share a true TX identity. The existing four-of-five source-L branch gate screens raw/As pairs; this does not prove physical identity preservation or target generalization. Existing consistency, physical augmentation and multibranch RFFI literature precludes a broad novelty claim.

candidates.mechanism: For the five deployed time, frequency, PA, SIG-TIME and reference paths, minimize same-packet cosine distance from two detached ordinary-view branch vectors to their corresponding certified physical-view vectors. Average branches and all source-U slots. Coefficient inherits original Tri joint-contrast weight, U weight and CE normalizer.

For certified physical slots, minimize KL from the mean detached softmax of the two ordinary fused logits to each of the two physical-view logits. Average all U slots. The coefficient inherits the original Tri physical-view CE dose and normalizer. This intentionally adds soft teacher consistency to physical U; the old As KL=0 setting applies only to the original within-pair KL, not this new term.
Apply both fixed branch and soft-prediction objectives with the same individual coefficients.

shared: Use existing four ordinary/mixed student passes and existing accepted, four-branch-certified, nonzero-strength As indices; no extra student forward. Raw features and soft teacher are detached. Preserve original U CE/KL masks, cross-day relations, original Tri mechanisms, per-branch U/L gradient guard and deployed classifier. The new source-U terms enter the same guard; no source-U TX truth or target data.
initialization: Exact matching source-only original Tri E20 prefix per model seed, then own E10+E20 to fixed E50/11100 updates; fixed graph permutation and original data roles.
evaluation: All nine candidate predictions frozen before independent truth-last score. Clean and six practical scenes, same physical IDs, DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary, cross_date separate from cross_rx/cross_both; report per-seed, scenario, TX/RX/day and same-packet corrections/regressions. No leo_weak, target-guided checkpoint selection or selective rerun. Each of three arms must be reported; no test-based candidate filtering.
success: Aim for greater than 2 percentage points over ordinary PL in clean and every practical DURA-LU scene and improvement over Tri, with individual seed/scene outcomes explicit. A positive result here cannot establish all-settings superiority.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --multilevel-physics --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: N607 ordinary account; immutable code release and unique run root; real source E20 no-query smoke across nine rows must verify selected physical slots and signature/reference gradients for each enabled objective.
resources: GPU 0–7, up to four observed or pending processes per GPU including other owners, with conservative memory reservation; existing fused-physics run and other healthy processes remain untouched.
stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch; preserve all healthy workers, output and failure evidence.
expected_artifacts: Nine genuine source E20 no-query smoke checks
Nine own E30/E50 models and component counters
Nine complete frozen predictions then independent matched three-seed and subgroup scores
